summary: Iteration 30 - Multi-Date Booking Slot Map Bug Fix Verification. All 5 MULTI-DATE test cases PASSED. The fetchSlots() fix using Promise.all for parallel date fetching works correctly. Blue info banner appears for multi-date selection. API called once per selected date. Order-independence of date selection confirmed.

MULTI-DATE-01.description: Single date (Mar 1) selected - parking map shows 10 slots (1A1-1A5, 1B1-1B5), NO blue multi-date banner shown

MULTI-DATE-02.description: Blue info banner appears with text 'Showing combined availability across all 2 selected dates. A slot is available only if it's free on every date.' when Mar 1 + Mar 2 selected
MULTI-DATE-02.note: When adding Mar 2 to existing Mar 1, Promise.all triggered 2 parallel API calls (one for Mar 01, one for Mar 02)

MULTI-DATE-03.description: Order independence verified: (a) Mar 1 first then Mar 3 = same slot availability as (b) Mar 3 first then Mar 1. All 10 slots show same state in both orderings. No order-dependent differences found.

MULTI-DATE-04.description: When 2 dates selected, exactly 2 API calls made to GET /api/slots/available (Promise.all fires one call per date). Verified via network request tracking.

MULTI-DATE-05.description: Single date regression: Mar 5 selected, shows '1 day' counter, no multi-date banner, parking map shows 10 slots, exactly 1 API call made with correct date=2026-03-05 parameter

critical_code_review_comments: BookingPage.js fetchSlots() (line 141-198): Conservative merge logic is correct - slot available only if free on ALL dates, timeline booked if booked on ANY date. The Promise.all implementation with catch(() => ({ data: [] })) provides good error resilience for individual date fetches.

Minor: fetchWaitlistInfo() (line 208-219) still uses only selectedDates[0] for waitlist check. For multi-date booking, waitlist should check all selected dates or prompt user to select a single date for waitlist. Not a bug but a potential UX concern for future consideration.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 multi-date booking slot map tests PASSED. The fix in BookingPage.js fetchSlots() correctly: (1) calls Promise.all for parallel date fetching when multiple dates selected, (2) merges slots conservatively (available only if free on ALL dates), (3) shows blue info banner [data-testid='multidate-availability-note'] when 2+ dates selected, (4) single-date path unchanged (no regression). Building used: CL Tower Makati (Main), Floor 1, March 2026 dates.
